canon.silhouette: tall and sealed - a squared two-step helm with a wide flared brim, pauldrons flush with the jaw so there is no neck, and a mail skirt widening the hips; the line soldier's outline with one more step on every edge
canon.reads_as: the same soldier as the line, with more between them and the dark

prompt.description: A veteran of the same line, wearing more of everything. A squared two-step metal helm with a flat crown block above a second flat block, over a wide flared brim with a single dark shadow row beneath it. Large pauldrons rise flush with the jaw so no neck shows at all, and the open face is a narrow slot between brim and shoulders. A plated torso, a heavy belt, a long mail skirt widening the hips, plated greaves and dark boots. The same plain vertical wooden spear as the line soldier.
must_include: a squared two-step helm - a flat-topped crown block above a second flat-topped block, not a smooth dome
a wide flared brim with exactly one dark shadow row beneath it
pauldrons rising flush with the jaw, no visible neck
an open face reduced to a narrow horizontal slot between brim and pauldrons
a long mail skirt widening the hips below the belt
the same plain wooden spear held dead vertical as the line soldier
must_avoid: visor, faceplate or any closed helm - the face must stay open
horn, trumpet or any curved object
cast shadow, doubled outlines or deep internal recesses between plates
lamp, torch, candle or visible flame
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
white or near-white highlights, specular glints
large solid black body mass, heavy internal outlining
